job.title: Founding AI Product Engineer
job.text:
Founding AI Product Engineer
Vantiq AI — Austin, TX (onsite, 6 days/week)

We are a pre-seed startup building the future of enterprise AI, looking for a founding team member who will treat this like their own company. This is not a 9-to-5. We work Monday through Saturday in office. If you need work-life balance this is not the role — we're a family here.

Responsibilities: own product strategy and roadmap; write and ship production backend and frontend code; fine-tune and deploy our models; run sales calls and close enterprise customers; handle support and onboarding; manage hiring.

Requirements: 15+ years of machine learning experience; expert-level knowledge of modern LLM tooling and agent frameworks; prior founding experience with a successful exit strongly preferred; available on Slack outside working hours including weekends.

Compensation: equity only for the first 6 months (0.25%–0.5%, subject to board approval), transitioning to market-rate salary once we close our seed round, expected in Q1.

Process: finalists complete an unpaid two-week trial project. Relocation to Austin required at the candidate's own expense.

(Fictional posting, written for this demo.)

reasoning: The posting asks a senior candidate to absorb nearly all of the risk — six months unpaid, self-funded relocation, an unpaid two-week trial — for sub-founder equity that is not guaranteed. The scope spans six distinct full-time jobs, including replacing an engineering team. Several stated preferences are violated simultaneously, and no external fact would change that.
strengths: Genuinely broad ownership, if the terms were different
Pre-seed AI product work would exercise the full range of the profile
concerns: Six months without salary, plus self-funded relocation and an unpaid two-week trial project
Scope spans product, engineering, ML, sales, support and hiring — six roles in one
Explicit rejection of work-life balance, six-day onsite weeks, required off-hours availability
15+ years ML experience alongside expert modern LLM and agent tooling is internally inconsistent — that tooling has not existed that long
Equity is below typical founding levels and conditioned on unstated board approval
research_summary: No searches performed. Every disqualifying term is stated in the posting itself, so no external information could change the recommendation.

agent_trace.message: The disqualifying facts here are all stated in the posting, not missing from it: unpaid period, self-funded relocation, unpaid trial, six-day onsite weeks, six-role scope. Research is only worth a call when it could change the answer.
Confirming the company's funding or reputation would not rescue these terms — a better-funded company offering the same package is still the same package. No search.

workflow_trace.detail: SKIP verdict — the CLI asks before generating, and the default is no. Nothing was written.

evidence_map.gap: ~4 years PM plus technical consulting. The requirement is also internally inconsistent with the modern LLM tooling asked for alongside it.

evidence_map.requirement: Ship production backend and frontend code
evidence_map.gap: Not a production engineer, and explicitly not seeking to substitute for one
Product ownership of model systems, not model training or deployment

evidence_map.requirement: Run sales calls and close enterprise customers
evidence_map.evidence: Enterprise client consulting at Fortune 500 scale

evidence_map.requirement: Prior founding experience with an exit
